newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania Dec '96 bank deposits up, loans fall.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania Dec '96 bank deposits up, loans fall.

text.p: Deposits edged up slightly in Lithuania's commercial banking sector in December 1996 while loans fell slightly, the central bank said on Friday.
Total deposits rose to 4.781 billion litas from 4.703 billion litas in November. Household deposits rose in the month to 1.713 billion litas from 1.663 billion.
Loans fell in December to 4.123 billion litas from 4.128 billion, the central bank said.
Total assets in the commercial banks grew to 6.792 billion litas from 6.605 billion in December.
